learning_outcomes.text: Explain realistic AI use cases across the CFO function
Use AI tools effectively and ground their output
Use AI to support analysis and reporting with review
Apply AI to support forecasting and scenarios
Govern AI use for risk, confidentiality and audit
Lead responsible, ethical AI adoption in finance

integrative_case: A CFO wants to use AI across the finance function without creating risk. Map suitable use cases, use AI to support commentary and forecasting with grounding and review, classify data and design an approval and audit trail, plan a safe pilot, and set a policy that handles confidentiality, accuracy and disclosure.
